messages:
zoe: hey team — first day here, trying to run CI for `search-service`. I triggered the Buildkite pipeline but the GH Actions runner step fails with a 403. error says: \"remote: repository not found\". I also haven't added my SSH key yet. do I need to accept a GH App or be added to a special team? who should I ping for access?

ryan: welcome Zoe :wave: quick checklist — 1) add your SSH pubkey to your GitHub profile 2) run `ssh -T git@github.com` and `gh auth status` to confirm auth 3) for GH App consent we usually ask new hires to accept the org GitHub App (CI Runner) when they first log in. sometimes org SSO or SCIM blocks it. I can check your membership.

maya: hi Zoe — can you paste the failing step log? sometimes Buildkite falls back to GH Actions but the runner user (the GH App installation) needs repo-level access. if you haven't added your SSH key, git fetch will fall back to https and fail if credentials missing.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `search-service/push` #402 failed on job `gha-runner` — exit code 128

zoe: here's the clipped log: ```
Fetching origin...
fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': No such device or address
remote: Repository not found.
fatal: repository 'https://github.com/redwood/search-service.git/' not found
```

zoe: also running `ssh -T git@github.com` gives: \"Permission denied (publickey).\"

ryan: yep that matches missing SSH key for your account. add your public key: `cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub | pbcopy` then paste into github.com/settings/keys. after that re-run `ssh -T git@github.com` until you see \"Hi zoe! You've successfully authenticated\".

ryan: about the GH App — I checked, you're not in the `ci-runners` team which grants the GH App installation repo access. i'll open a quick invite and ping infra to approve org app consent if needed.

maya: adding: if the pipeline still tries https, check your repo remote: `git remote -v` should show `git@github.com:...` not `https://`. run `git remote set-url origin git@github.com:redwood/search-service.git` to fix.

infra-bot: infra:link created issue #2185 — \"Add zoe to ci-runners team / check GH App consent\" (assigned to ryan)

ryan: done — invited you to `ci-runners` and re-requested the GH App installation for `search-service`. once you accept you'll have the runner perms. i also set your remote to SSH for you (pushed a tiny PR to your fork with the config change).

zoe: accepted the invite and added my SSH key. after re-running the Buildkite job locally (and re-triggering from the UI) the pipeline advanced past the gha-runner step. :tada:

maya: awesome — welcome aboard! if you hit anything else ping #eng-infra or @ryan.

zoe: thanks both, appreciate the speedy help :raised_hands:

ryan: marked issue #2185 resolved. closing the loop: root cause was missing SSH key + not being in `ci-runners` team; GH App lacked installation until invite accepted. notes for onboarding doc: remind new hires to add SSH key, check `git remote -v`, and accept GH App consent.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `search-service/push` #403 succeeded on job `gha-runner` — duration 1m12s
